arxiv-2303-12494.title: Automated Radiation Therapy Patient Scheduling: A Case Study at a Belgian Hospital
arxiv-2303-12494.creator: Sara Frimodig, Carole Mercier, Geert De Kerf
arxiv-2303-12494.description: Abstract The predicted increase in the number of patients receiving radiation therapy (RT) to treat cancer calls for an optimized use of resources. To manually schedule patients on the linear accelerators delivering RT is a time-consuming and challenging task. Operations research (OR), a discipline in applied mathematics, uses a variety of analytical methods to improve decision-making.

arxiv-2512-10049.title: Adaptive Nonparametric Estimation via Kernel Transport on Group Orbits: Oracle Inequalities and Minimax Rates
arxiv-2512-10049.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We develop a unified framework for nonparametric functional estimation based on kernel transport along orbits of discrete group actions, which we term Twin Spaces . Given a base kernel K K and a group G = ⟨ φ ⟩ G=\langle\varphi\rangle acting isometrically on the input space E E , we construct a hierarchy of transported kernels { K j } j ≥ 0 \{K_{j}\}_{j\geq 0} and a penalized model selection scheme satisfying a Kraft inequality.

pmc-10572194.title: Cultivated Land Demand and Pressure in Southeast Asia from 1961 to 2019: A Comprehensive Study on Food Consumption
pmc-10572194.creator: Yuting Qin, Jiayue Tang, Tanglu Li, Xin Qi, Dan Zhang, Sijia Wang, Fei Lun, Alfredo Cassano
pmc-10572194.description: Southeast Asia plays a crucial role in global food production and trade, yet it grapples with challenges related to food security, regional stability, and security. Cultivated land is the material foundation for ensuring food production. With the development of society and the economy, people’s food consumption has undergone significant changes.

pmc-10676326.title: Analytical and Functional Similarity of the Biosimilar Candidate ABP 654 to Ustekinumab Reference Product
pmc-10676326.creator: Greg Cantin, Qian Liu, Bhavana Shah, Scott Kuhns, Mats Wikström, Shawn Cao, Jennifer Liu
pmc-10676326.description: Background and ObjectiveABP 654 is a proposed biosimilar to ustekinumab reference product (RP), a human immunoglobulin isotype class G subclass 1 kappa monoclonal antibody that acts as an antagonist of interleukin (IL)-23 and IL-12. Ustekinumab RP is indicated for the treatment of some forms of plaque psoriasis, active psoriatic arthritis, Crohn’s disease, and ulcerative colitis.

pmc-11391316.title: Skill building in freediving as an example of embodied culture
pmc-11391316.creator: Greg Downey
pmc-11391316.description: Skilled activity is a complex mix of automatized action, changed attention patterns, cognitive strategies and physiological adaptations developed within a community of practice. Drawing on physiological and ethnographic research on freediving, this article argues that skill acquisition demonstrates the variety of mechanisms that link biological and cultural processes to produce culturally shaped forms of embodiment.

pmc-12451369.title: Assessment of heavy metal exposure and cancer risk in Addis Ababa: Trends, risk factors and demographic variations in urinary cadmium, lead and chromium levels
pmc-12451369.creator: Tsigereda Assefa Alemayehu, Andualem Mekonnen Hiruy, Mehari Meles, Belay Tefera, Tadesse Alemu Terfie
pmc-12451369.description: This study aims to assess the exposure levels of Pb, Cd, and Cr and evaluate trends in heavy metal exposure among the population of Addis Ababa. A cross-sectional study was conducted involving 417 participants randomly selected from the population. Spot urine and water samples, socio-demographic characteristics, and food consumption frequency were collected.

pmc-12565332.title: High-Seas Marine Microorganism Delivers an Extract That Dampens LPS-Driven Pro-Inflammatory Signaling: Galbibacter orientalis Strain ROD011
pmc-12565332.creator: Minji Kim, You-Jin Jeon, Bomi Ryu, Young-Mog Kim, Jae-Il Kim, Minkyeong Choi, Sohee Kim, Jihye Lee, Jimin Hyun
pmc-12565332.description: An ethyl acetate extract from the deep-sea bacterium Galbibacter orientalis strain ROD011 (GOEE), collected from international waters, was investigated as a potential anti-inflammatory agent. In lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated murine macrophages, nitric oxide (NO) production fell by 72–87% at 5–20 µg/mL GOEE without detectable cytotoxicity. Cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2 protein abundance decreased in a dose-dependent manner and was nearly absent at 20 µg/mL.

pmc-12587466.title: A Systematic Review of Platelet‐Rich Plasma Versus Platelet‐Rich Fibrin for Periorbital Rejuvenation
pmc-12587466.creator: Catherine F. Sollitto, Maxim Narduzzi, Claire Wolinsky
pmc-12587466.description: BackgroundPlatelet‐rich plasma (PRP) and platelet‐rich fibrin (PRF) have become popular autologous options for facial rejuvenation due to their regenerative potential and favorable safety profiles. The periorbital region remains one of the most challenging treatment sites, as conventional approaches such as hyaluronic acid fillers carry a risk of complications and may not provide natural, sustained results.

pmc-13314717.title: Targeting Temozolomide‐Resistant Glioblastoma: Therapeutic Potential of Neuronal Nitric Oxide Synthase Inhibitor
pmc-13314717.creator: Mallikarjuna Nimgampalle, Shashank Kumar Ojha, Maryam Kartawy, Michelle Feivelson, Haitham Amal
pmc-13314717.description: Background and PurposeThe treatment of glioblastoma remains a major clinical challenge, largely due to intrinsic and acquired resistance to Temozolomide (TMZ). We aim to advance a novel therapeutic approach to overcome TMZ resistance in human glioblastoma by using the neuronal nitric oxide synthase inhibitor BA‐101 as both a monotherapy and an adjuvant therapy.

pmc-13358223.title: Identification of a locus associated with chlorosis and antioxidant capacity using RNA-seq and BSA-seq in soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr]
pmc-13358223.creator: Duo Lv, Lihua Zhu, Jiaqi You, Biting Cao, Hongjuan Yang, Weihong Gu, Qingzhu Li, Yuan Yuan, Chaohan Li
pmc-13358223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Plant coloration is an important trait in soybean (Glycine max), and its underlying molecular mechanisms are complex. In this study, we identified a chlorotic mutant, el-5y, in the wild-type soybean cultivar VS-5. Compared with those in VS-5, the capacities for photosynthesis, photosynthetic pigment synthesis, and antioxidant production in the el-5y mutant were significantly decreased, leading to a significant decrease in production.

pmc-13507092.title: Pore-scale modelling of methane-driven helium extraction in deep tight sandstones
pmc-13507092.creator: Hao Zhao, Bowen Zhang, Jingong Zhang, Linyu Liu, Yiqing Yang, Yanan Zhou, Rui Kang
pmc-13507092.description: Helium is a strategic resource for cryogenic, aerospace, semiconductor, and other advanced technologies, but in deep tight sandstone reservoirs it may occur partly as dissolved helium in formation water, and its transfer into a producible gas phase remains poorly quantified.
